title: Resorts International, Intertel and Donald Trump
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Resorts International, Intertel and Donald Trump, about 1980s at Bahamas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> There's this paint company called the Merry Carter Paint Company which is then converted into this organization called Resorts International. It suddenly has a subsidiary which has a private intelligence network called Intertel
Which then gets rebranded into what's called International Intelligence Incorporated. Intertel.
tellings.difference: Credits Meyer Lansky, places it on Paradise Island in the 1960s-1970s, and does not mention Trump.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell how the Mary Carter Paint Company became Resorts International, with Intertel as its private intelligence subsidiary, in the Bahamas.
